features.name: Walking skeleton, part 2: search on local Atlas
features.description: MovieRepository and CandidateSearch on mongodb-atlas-local pinned to an exact 8.0 tag: vector index create/update/drop from code, every pre-filter verified together with a 5,000-id exclusion list, the audience rule (Atlas pre-filter or step 4), database down maps to 503, a seed script for spike 16's 300 films (re-fetched from TMDB, never committed), testcontainers, and a CI integration job. Answers Q4 on Windows. Detail: docs/backlog.md, feat-030 section.

features.name: Walking skeleton, part 3: real embedder
features.description: The fastembed BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384-d) Embedder adapter in infra: verify that query_embed adds BGE's query instruction, embed the 300 seeded profiles with template(profile) (ADR 0007), and measure cold-start and warm query-embedding time end to end. Detail: docs/backlog.md, feat-028 section.

features.name: Walking skeleton, part 4: real LLM
features.description: The Pydantic AI LanguageModel adapter (OpenAIChatModel, gpt-6-luna, NativeOutput, reasoning_effort none; ADR 0006): the step-2 and step-6 check functions as output validators, with one retry that feeds the error back, verified on the real model; real tokens and cost in the trace; the deterministic evals re-run on the real model; first end-to-end latency numbers (Q7). Small paid spend (cents). Detail: docs/backlog.md, feat-029 section.

features.name: Reviewer spike checklist, cross-tool review, and stale-number cleanup
features.description: From the 2026-11-16 checkpoint review (findings 3 and 8). (1) Add a spike and design-document section to .agents/agents/reviewer.md: every number traced to a raw output file; each labelled measured, estimated or from documentation (with link and date); extrapolations and sample sizes stated; options not run marked as not run; licence and terms claims quoted; handoff and metrics summaries say no more than the report. (2) A rule in AGENTS.md and docs/workflow.md that spikes and design documents are reviewed with the other machine's tool before merge. (3) Fix the stale lines the review lists (docs/metrics.md sections 1.3-1.4, README stack and status, the spike 11 and 16 summaries) and reduce docs/metrics.md section 1.4 to links. (4) Make references findable (owner, 2026-11-24): give each query step in docs/architecture.md section 3 its own heading, and add a /spec rule that every reference to another document links to its section on first use, with the name that document uses (one source per fact; specs and guides link, never copy). Detail: docs/backlog.md (Proposed, moved 2026-11-21 and 2026-11-24).

features.name: Spike: quality and notability signals beyond TMDB, and a more generous corpus gate
features.description: Answer the questions in docs/spikes/26-quality-and-notability-signals.md: free, licence-clean signals beyond TMDB (Wikidata critics, awards, box office, Wikipedia languages and page views, Trakt), their coverage and distinctness, a more generous 'any signal' gate rated by the owner (keep old but popular films such as Mission: Impossible II), corpus size and cost, ranking inputs per acclaim preference, and content in the search (genre and people mirror fields, content in the vector text; dilution and over-filtering tested). $0 except question 7 (about $0.01-0.05). Owner decisions of 2026-11-21 are recorded in the spike file.

features.name: Content limits in the search: genre, director, main cast, keyword flags
features.description: Owner requirement (2026-11-24): the v1 list of hard limits is not frozen (ADR 0005). Build what spike feat-026 question 7 recommends: new QueryIntent fields and intent-prompt rules (a required genre, 'only horror', versus a preferred one, 'an action movie'), the mirror fields (genres and credits are already in the data model), their pre-filter paths and step-4 checks, content in the vector text if recommended, and the evals extended to content requests. Detail: docs/backlog.md, feat-031 section.

features.name: Profile design and owner-rated sample
features.description: Finalize the v1 profile vocabulary with anchored definitions (viewing_effort, tone), the enrichment prompt and prompt_version, whether profiles keep an evidence field, and a profile-quality eval on ~30 films the owner rates (ADR 0005).
